response.text:
I don't see the photo here — could you upload it? 

Also quick questions so I match your request:
- Do you want a solid pale blue or a subtle gradient? (If you don't care, I'll use a solid pale blue.)
- Any specific shade (hex) — or is a soft pale blue like #E6F2FF okay?
- Keep the product's original shadow/reflection and edges as-is? (I can preserve them for a natural look.)
- Output format: keep original (JPEG/PNG) or prefer PNG?

Send the image and confirm any of the above (or say "use defaults") and I'll edit it.
